messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High GPU queue growth observed in us-west-2-hosted cluster (redwood-dedicated-prod). Autoscaler failed to increase capacity due to placement constraints. Queues > 3000 reqs, 95th latency spike, and 429 throttles starting 03:14 UTC.

adele_ops: i'm oncall, looking now. seeing a ton of 'no placement' logs from the scheduler.

punit_k: what does "no placement" look like? MIG slices mismatched?

lara_m: logs show binpack failure when trying to place 1xA100(40G) MIG slices; many nodes have leftover 7G/13G slices that can't fit 40G reqs. we have a lot of small-slice workloads pinned.

emily_r: customer impact: two dedicated customers in us-west-2 reporting 5xx/429s. ticket numbers: #C-4019, #C-4023. front door metrics show requests enqueued and tail latency > 30s.

adele_ops: confirming autoscaler attempted +8 GPUs but kube-scheduler rejected placements because of MIG fragmentation. autoscaler then hit limit (max=12) and started throttling.

punit_k: timeline: autoscale spike at 03:14 -> scale requests 03:15-03:18 -> placement failures 03:18 -> queue growing 03:20 -> rate limiting 03:22. we need immediate mitigation to reduce customer impact.

lara_m: quick mitigations idea list: 1) temporarily increase autoscale max to 24 (if quota) 2) evict/pool small-slice workloads to free contiguous slices 3) fallback route to compatible smaller-model replica (degraded quality) 4) manual placement override for pending jobs.

adele_ops: checking quota & cost: raising to 24 ok for short window. but that won't help if slices still fragmented.

srebot: (automated) Cluster quota available GPUs: 28, used: 18, reserved for other tenants: 2.

punit_k: step 1: bump autoscaler limit now; step 2: grad eviction plan for pinned small-slice jobs. i'll run the autoscale patch and start eviction plan. adele, can you coordinate customer comms?

adele_ops: on it. sending short notice to C-4019 and C-4023: "We are mitigating a GPU placement issue causing throttles; degrading to smaller model and temporary capacity increase being applied."

punit_k: applying autoscaler patch:
```
kubectl -n infra patch hpa gpu-autoscaler -p '{"spec": {"maxReplicas": 24}}'
```

punit_k: applied at 03:28 UTC. requesting additional nodes via cloud provider (on-call infra quota team alerted).

lara_m: starting eviction sweep script to consolidate free contiguous MIG slices:
```
# drain small-slice pool nodes, migrate pods
for node in $(kubectl get nodes -l mig-pool=small -o name); do
  kubectl cordon $node && kubectl drain $node --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force &
done
```

emily_r: routing fallback enabled for affected customers at 03:33: set route to smaller-model (costlier quality) for critical traffic. reduced 429s but latency still high.

adele_ops: customers ack receipt; one wants ETA for full recovery. advising 45-60m for consolidation + scale-up.

srebot: (automated) New nodes provisioned: 6 GPUs coming up, expected ready 03:42.

punit_k: nodes came up 03:43, but scheduler still shows 60% of capacity 'unusable' due to MIG slice mismatch. looks like existing pods still occupying odd slice sizes.

lara_m: manual step: for 4 nodes with badly fragmented GPUs, we'll evict low-priority pods, reboot nodes to reset MIG partitioning, and let cloud-init apply correct partition profile. risky but faster than live compaction.

adele_ops: do we have a rollback plan if reboots cause more disruption?

punit_k: yes - we will do staggered reboots with traffic routing disabled to those nodes. fallback routes live. each node reboot window ~ 90s. doing one at a time.

emily_r: performing node1 reboot (node-uw2-a-04) now. progress updates: reboot started 03:50.

lara_m: node came up with corrected MIG profile 03:52, scheduler placed pending pods onto freshly available 40G slices. queue drained slightly.

punit_k: continuing reboots until fragmentation reduced. currently 3/4 nodes done.

adele_ops: monitoring customer queues, throttles decreased from peak 18% -> 3% now. still seeing occasional tail spikes.

srebot: (automated) Queue length: 03:40=3020, 03:50=1200, 03:55=420, 04:00=80.

punit_k: after last node, placement success increased and autoscaler stabilized at 20 replicas. we've reduced throttling and 95p latency back to SLO for most customers.

emily_r: sending customer update: "We applied temporary capacity increase and node consolidation; service is recovering. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline for prevention."

adele_ops: handing incident to punit for postmortem + follow-ups. I'm going off-call in 15m.

punit_k: taking over incident lead. action items: *persist logs + placement traces*, *run binpack simulation on staging*, *evaluate automated defragmentation or 'compaction' workflow*, *consider autoscale policy change to prefer newer contiguous nodes*.

lara_m: +1. also need to review MIG sizing defaults; a bunch of long-running small-slice jobs should be schedulable in a separate 'small-pool' to avoid poisoning binpack.

emily_r: I'll open customer RCA draft and include mitigation timeline + impact metrics.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (partial): Throttling reduced and customer traffic recovered. Postmortem required.

punit_k: closing for now. will ping when postmortem is ready. great team work. :thumbsup:
